hint_password: Passwords are stored encrypted. Asterisk only gets an MD5 hash of them. An empty password is generated randomly when the instance starts.
hint_pinning: WebRTC requires an encrypted connection (WSS). Apps check the self-signed certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint. Browsers must accept it once: open the test page and confirm the security warning.

help_cert_hosts: Under these addresses the clients connect to Asterisk
confirm_regenerate: The fingerprint changes. All apps and browsers have to accept the new certificate again. Save the settings afterwards.

help_docker: The container uses host networking (Linux only). Asterisk is installed into it on the first start, which takes a few minutes.

hint_external: Asterisk runs elsewhere on this host: mount the configuration directory to /etc/asterisk/iobroker and include the generated files. See README.
help_config_dir: The generated files are written here and mounted into the container. Empty = data directory of the instance

help_codecs: Browsers support Opus, G.722 and G.711. SIP endpoints never get Opus. Opus is used only if the module is available
